svg.title: Flaire
svg.desc: Flaire. A cosmetics catalog with a social layer: reviews, follows and suggestions from your network. Built with Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Neo4j, Python, Docker.
svg.text: A cosmetics catalog with a social layer: reviews, follows and
suggestions from your network. 4,500 products and 90,000
reviews scraped from Sephora and Cult Beauty, split between
MongoDB and a Neo4j social graph.
Java · Spring Boot · MongoDB · Neo4j · Python · Docker
